name: Exeaon Research Reproduction Benchmark (starter)
note: A fixed set of reproduction TASKS (reproduce each `target`, then benchmark_submit(task_id, claimed) — a NUMBER for `type`:numeric tasks, a STRING for `type`:exact; benchmark_report aggregates matched/total). This committed file is only a small PUBLIC sample — the FULL ~600-task bar is generated LOCALLY by scripts/build-benchmark.py into benchmarks.local.json (gitignored, holds the reference answers; the MCP merges both and HIDES `reference`). Sources: CORE-Bench (arXiv:2409.11363, numeric+categorical) and QRData (arXiv:2402.17644, quantitative reasoning over real CSVs; `dataUrl` points at the data file). IMPORTANT: CORE-Bench's TEST answers are encrypted on purpose (anti-leakage) — never commit protected answers here. Every committed `reference` MUST be a value a source actually states (cite it in `provenance`) or one Exeaon independently measured. Never invent a reference.
